baseline_models.focus_anchor: The deictic-purpose construction "that, so that he may know" joined to the denial "in absence/the unseen."
baseline_models.mechanism: A prior act is framed as proof-making: it converts conduct unavailable to sight into something an absent knower can recognize.

activation_trace.role: Disclosure to a knower supplies the epistemic endpoint of the purpose clause.
A distinguishing trace supplies the evidentiary means by which hidden fidelity becomes knowable.
Screening from eyes supplies the inaccessible domain that the evidentiary act must cross.

changed_reading.before: A speaker simply says that another person should believe a denial.
changed_reading.after: The speaker identifies a prior act as an evidentiary device that makes unseen loyalty publicly or personally recognizable.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same betrayal root appears in the first-person denial and in the closing plural class of betrayers.
baseline_models.mechanism: The repeated root moves from one denied act to a general trust-accounting category: secret betrayal is both breach and subtraction from another's due.

activation_trace.role: Deficit in fidelity supplies the breached-trust category shared by the denial and the plural maxim.
Diminution supplies the more exact mechanism: an absent person's right or deposit has not been reduced.
Concealment from observation makes preservation of trust testable precisely when oversight is absent.

changed_reading.before: The denial concerns generic personal disloyalty.
changed_reading.after: The denial claims that no entrusted right was secretly breached or diminished, then tests the claim against the general class of betrayers.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The negated verb of guidance governs the intensive scheme of betrayers.
baseline_models.mechanism: Guidance contributes direction, course, and arrival; plotting contributes strenuous manipulation. Their combination makes the maxim causal: treacherous labor is denied a viable route to its intended end.

activation_trace.role: Gentle direction toward a road or truth supplies the route that the negation withholds.
An affair's course and aim supply the plot's intended trajectory, which is denied stable direction.
Strenuous handling supplies the plot's effortful construction rather than a momentary bad impulse.
Intrigue supplies the concealed design whose path to success is blocked.
Breach of trust identifies why the scheme is placed under the no-guidance rule.

changed_reading.before: The closing clause is only a detached moral slogan.
changed_reading.after: It states a mechanism: a trust-breaking design may be strenuous and clever yet cannot acquire a durable course to its intended end.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context repeatedly moves from opaque appearance and failed knowing to return, questioning, and manifested truth. The focus purpose clause therefore names the endpoint of a procedure, not merely a transfer of private assurance.

activation_trace.role: Dream-vision supplies an initially opaque object whose truth cannot be read directly from appearance.
Disclosure to a knower is explicitly negated here, marking the failure of authoritative-looking interpreters.
A recognizable marker supplies the messenger's aim of carrying an answer back so people can know.
Return to an earlier point supplies the procedural reversal that reopens the unresolved record.
Questioning and requesting supply the fact-finding operation inserted before release.
Truth coming out of concealment supplies the inquiry's visible result.
Stable correspondence with reality supplies the standard by which testimony becomes more than assertion.
A distinguishing trace makes the focus act the final evidentiary marker in the sequence.
What was unavailable to sight defines the evidentiary gap that the inquiry closes.

structural_cues: 12:43-46 stage a movement from unreadable vision and confessed nonknowledge toward knowledge carried back to people.
12:50 reverses an immediate summons into a question about the women.
12:51 places collective testimony and a confession directly before the focus purpose clause.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opacity, failed knowing, return, questioning, and manifested truth; I infer that this sequence causes the knowledge sought in 12:52. A live alternative is that these are adjacent episodes and the focus only states a personal motive.

changed_reading.before: A prior statement simply informs one man that the speaker is innocent.
changed_reading.after: The deictic points to a deliberately reopened inquiry whose tested record converts conduct in absence into warranted knowledge.

context_deltas.mechanism: One live speaker model resumes the voice that demanded inquiry: the return produces testimony of established truthfulness, and the focus explains why release was delayed until another man could know the absent trust had not been breached.

activation_trace.role: Returning the messenger supplies the exonerated speaker's last explicit action before the intervening hearing.
Complete soundness and stability supply the testimony that can support a resumed claim of fidelity.
Breach of trust supplies the specific charge the resumed voice denies.
Settled security and trust supply the narrative result of the exonerated-voice reading.

structural_cues: 12:50 gives the imprisoned interpreter a first-person command to reopen the case.
12:51 embeds several quoted voices before 12:52 begins without a speaker tag.
12:54 answers the inquiry with an explicit judgment of trustworthiness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the demand for inquiry, intervening testimony, and later trust; I infer an unmarked return to the earlier speaker in 12:52. The materially live alternative is continuous speech by the woman who confessed at the end of 12:51.

changed_reading.before: The speaker and the male pronoun remain wholly indeterminate.
changed_reading.after: One coherent reading hears the exonerated prisoner resume after the hearing and explain that he withheld easy release so the absent male whose trust mattered would know it had been preserved.

context_deltas.mechanism: A competing model keeps the immediately preceding female confessor as speaker through 12:52 and into 12:53. Her confession then becomes a present act of nonbetrayal: she admits solicitation but refuses to continue injuring the absent man through concealment or false attribution.

activation_trace.role: Solicitation supplies the wrongdoing explicitly admitted rather than erased by the focus denial.
Emergence from concealment supplies confession as a restorative act in the present.
Failure of fidelity supplies the category she now refuses to extend through a hidden falsehood.
Diminishing another's due supplies the narrower sense in which truthful confession stops further injury.
Distancing oneself from blame is explicitly refused, preventing the nonbetrayal claim from becoming total acquittal.
The self as the very person supplies first-person continuity and keeps responsibility attached to the confessor.

structural_cues: 12:51 ends with a woman's first-person confession immediately before the untagged first person of 12:52.
12:53 continues in first person with no named speaker and explicitly refuses self-acquittal.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacent untagged first-person clauses, confession, and non-acquittal; I infer one continuous female voice and distinguish attempted solicitation from later hidden falsification. The live alternative is a speaker resumption in 12:52 followed by another switch in 12:53.

changed_reading.before: The verse is an uncomplicated declaration by the person just exonerated.
changed_reading.after: On the continuity reading, it is the confessor's claim that telling the truth now does not betray the absent man, while the next verse preserves her admission of moral vulnerability.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context names the women's intrigue and then stages truth becoming manifest. The focus no-guidance clause can therefore be read dynamically: the plot fails to reach concealment and instead becomes material for disclosure.

activation_trace.role: A concrete intrigue supplies the immediate instance later placed under the general no-guidance rule.
Truth emerging into view supplies the outcome opposite to successful concealment.
Establishing and displaying what is true supplies the plot's evidentiary reversal.
Direction toward a road or truth supplies the destination that treacherous intrigue cannot secure.
Concealed design links the local intrigue to the focus's general plural category.

structural_cues: 12:50 ends by naming the women's plot as known.
12:51 immediately turns interrogation into collective testimony and confession.
12:52 changes the singular local event into a general statement about plots of betrayers.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a named plot followed by exposed truth; I supply the directional arrow that failed concealment produces disclosure. A live alternative treats the final clause as moral commentary rather than a description of the preceding reversal.

changed_reading.before: God simply disapproves of betrayers' plans.
changed_reading.after: The local plot demonstrates the maxim operationally: its intended path toward concealment collapses and the scheme becomes evidence that exposes itself.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate refusal of self-acquittal narrows the focus denial. It can assert fidelity in one specified absent relation without claiming an intrinsically pure or temptation-proof self.

activation_trace.role: A specific breach of trust supplies the bounded conduct denied in the focus.
Separation from liability is refused, blocking conversion of a specific defense into comprehensive innocence.
The inward faculty supplies the site of continuing moral pressure beneath the outwardly vindicated act.
Insistent direction supplies the self's active pressure toward wrongdoing.
Moral ugliness supplies the object toward which the inner pressure tends.
Tender mercy supplies the stated exception to self-command, relocating safety outside self-certification.

structural_cues: 12:53 follows the focus with an adversative refusal to acquit the self.
The first-person continuity is possible but not marked, so the qualification may be intrapersonal or juxtaposed across speakers.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a particular nonbetrayal claim followed by non-acquittal, inner command, evil, and mercy; I infer that the latter bounds the former. If the speaker changes, the bound remains a contextual juxtaposition but is less securely the first speaker's self-qualification.

changed_reading.before: The speaker offers an absolute certificate of personal innocence.
changed_reading.after: The claim is conduct-specific: this trust was not betrayed, while the self remains morally vulnerable and dependent on mercy.

context_deltas.mechanism: After the focus, purification from suspicion becomes trust, guardianship, and nonloss. The private claim of not diminishing an absent person's due is thus activated as a credential for preserving a public deposit.

activation_trace.role: Diminution supplies the negative trust operation that later stewardship must reverse.
Purification from mixture supplies the transition from a contested record to selected service.
Settled confidence supplies the institutional judgment produced by demonstrated fidelity.
Active guarding supplies the positive counterpart to secretly diminishing a trust.
Loss and disappearance, here negated, supply the outcome that faithful custody prevents.

structural_cues: 12:54 names the vindicated figure secure and trusted.
12:55 immediately joins guardianship and knowledge to responsibility for the land's stores.
12:56 closes the sequence with empowerment and a statement that good work is not lost.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exoneration, trustworthiness, a guardianship claim, and nonloss; I infer that demonstrated private fidelity licenses public custody. A live alternative is that appointment rests only on interpretive expertise and administrative knowledge.

changed_reading.before: The verse settles only a private accusation.
changed_reading.after: It also forms a hinge from invisible fidelity to visible office: one who did not diminish a private trust can be presented as fit to guard public stores.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the material image of hidden roots rather than the ordinary sense of absence. It remains anchored in the focus unseen-root and in the local question-to-disclosure sequence; downstream prose should present it as an evidentiary analogy, not as a replacement lexical translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The phrase "in the unseen/absence" is joined to a purpose of making another know.

activation_trace.role: Roots hidden underground but recoverable by digging supply the image of a record latent beneath visibility.
A distinguishing trace supplies the recovered evidence by which the hidden record can be recognized.
Questioning supplies the local analogue of digging into what was not directly seen.
Emergence of concealed truth supplies the moment when latent evidence reaches the surface.

changed_reading.before: Absence is merely the time when the other person was not present.
changed_reading.after: Absence is also an evidentiary depth: integrity leaves hidden roots that a disciplined inquiry can excavate and make legible.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is form-distant because it uses the packet's non-dominant mapped branch for the guidance root. It remains valid as a contained shadow-reading because the focus opposes knowing to a plot denied guidance and the context moves through supposition, mixed dreams, and established truth; render it as a secondary semantic pressure, never as the primary morphology.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus opposes the purpose "that he may know" to the claim that a betrayer's plot is not guided.

activation_trace.role: An unconfirmed image entertained in the mind supplies a form-distant pressure toward unstable conjecture.
Disclosure to a knower supplies the stable epistemic state that conjectural plotting fails to reach.
Uncertainty and imagining supply an earlier local state of inference without full establishment.
Mixed dream matter supplies epistemic entanglement that resists reliable direction.
Reality-stable truth supplies the endpoint against which mere conjecture is exposed.

changed_reading.before: The plot merely fails in an external practical sense.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it also fails epistemically: treacherous construction cannot stabilize imagined suspicion into truth, while inquiry can move hidden conduct into knowledge.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is cross-domain because it transfers the surrounding grain-preservation mechanism into interpersonal and institutional trust. It remains anchored in the focus branch of betrayal as diminution and is bracketed by leaving, fortifying, and storing; downstream prose should call it a material analogy that sharpens the claim, not a literal equation of persons with grain.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The denial of secretly diminishing a trust stands between instructions for preserving scarce stores and a later claim to guard treasuries.

activation_trace.role: Leaving something in place supplies the first conservation operation instead of immediate consumption.
Preservation within a surrounding protection supplies resistance to depletion during severe time.
Diminution supplies the shared negative operation: consuming or reducing what should remain intact for another.
An unseen interval supplies the period during which preservation cannot depend on external observation.
Securing something in storage supplies the later institutional scale of the same conservation logic.
Watchful guarding supplies the agentive virtue that keeps a reserve or right from being diminished.

changed_reading.before: Nonbetrayal is only abstention from a prohibited personal act.
changed_reading.after: It becomes conservation under absent oversight: the faithful person does not consume another's due and is thereby legible as a guardian of larger stores.

strongest_changes: The focus purpose clause becomes the endpoint of a returned, question-driven evidentiary procedure.
The no-guidance maxim becomes a local reversal in which intrigue fails to preserve concealment and produces disclosure.
Two speaker readings remain live: resumption by the exonerated prisoner and continuity by the female confessor.
The following self-accounting bounds the nonbetrayal claim, while later trust and guardianship extend private fidelity toward public stewardship.
summary.what_was_special: The packet activated procedural knowledge, an unresolved voice boundary, and a conservation mechanism around one compact denial. The odd but anchored readings were especially productive: hidden integrity as excavated evidence, unguided plotting as conjecture that cannot stabilize, and betrayal-as-diminution linking grain storage to entrusted office.
remaining_uncertainties: The untagged speaker transitions across 12:51-53 do not decide between the two coherent first-person continuities.
The male knower and the antecedent of the deictic remain underdetermined even when the inquiry sequence is clear.
The arrow from failed plot to disclosure is abductive; the clauses may instead be juxtaposed as event and moral maxim.
The hidden-root and conservation readings are controlled analogies, not primary lexical claims.
